mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.study_no AS studyNo, p.name, p.gender, p.card_no AS cardNo, p.follow_cycle AS followCycle, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate, IFNULL(v.visitCount, 0) AS visitCount, DATE_FORMAT(v.lastVisit, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastVisitDate FROM patient_basic_info p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND research_type IN ()) d ON d.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS visitCount, MAX(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS lastVisit FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.research_type IN () AND f.patient_basic_info_id IN (SELECT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ()) GROUP BY f.patient_basic_info_id) v ON v.pid = p.id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_relation_doctor w WHERE w.patient_id = p.id AND w.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND w.miss = 1 AND w.research_type IN ())
